set.body: Implements the 2026-10-09 owner decision on bd-01M2R18YTC8BF4T1890QX991RW. Today AoiAssignment.measure works over Recording samples only; runCount counts maximal runs of consecutive member samples, so a saccade or blink between two contained fixations splits a visit. Deliver (split into half-day slices before editing): (1) a fixation-level AOI measurement over Scanpath (dwell, first entry, entry count, visit count) where a visit survives intervening non-member support between consecutive contained fixations, under the existing MembershipPolicy and frame Agreement; (2) rename the sample-level AoiMetric.runCount to an explicit name (e.g. sampleRunCount) before the 1.0 binary freeze; (3) AoiLaws: fixation-level visit laws (visit count <= contained fixation count; all-contained scanpath has exactly one visit) mutation-verified, and the existing 'blocks' law kept for the sample measure; (4) eyesim parity note in PARITY.md; codec/TidyResult export columns updated. CR7 of docs/plans/CORE_READINESS_PLAN.md.
set.title: CR7: fixation-level AOI visits, entries and dwell over Scanpath; name the sample-level run count explicitly
